title: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Polycab India approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year.
rawText: In continuation of our letter dated October 27, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, has, inter alia:1. approved the unaudited Financial Results (Consolidated and Standalone) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and2. passed an enabling resolution authorising the issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures up to Rs. 15,000 crore, in one or more tranches, on private placement basis.

title: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
summary: Board meeting scheduled to consider financial results and fund raising.
rawText: The meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve a. the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and b. raising of funds by way of issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures on private placement basis, in one or more tranches. The Company will hold an analyst meet, post the Board Meeting, to discuss the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

title: General Updates
summary: Jio Platforms trading start and board meeting scheduled for financial results.
rawText: Trading in equity shares of Jio Platforms Limited (JPL) will commence from October 28, 2026.Further, a meeting of board of directors of JPL is scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of JPL for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
